= Polyfills

Polyfills and shims for adding missing or newer JavaScript and browser
features to older environments.

* https://github.com/Modernizr/Modernizr/wiki/HTML5-Cross-Browser-Polyfills[Modernizr: List of Cross-Browser-Polyfills]
* https://olivernn.github.io/augment.js/[augment.js]
* https://github.com/zloirock/core-js[core-js]
* https://github.com/es-shims/es5-shim[es5-shim]
* https://afarkas.github.io/webshim/demos/[webshim]
